original_ai_output.title_zh: 法国与丹麦国防武官：埃塞俄比亚应加入地区机制以维护红海安全
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 法国与丹麦驻埃塞俄比亚国防武官在亚的斯亚贝巴表示，埃塞俄比亚对红海出海通道的诉求具有正当性，并应作为地区大国参与维护红海及非洲之角海上安全与反恐的地区机制。法方武官称应通过对话与谈判解决埃塞俄比亚出海通道问题。上述表态由埃塞俄比亚通讯社单一来源报道。

key_facts.fact: 法国与丹麦驻埃塞俄比亚国防武官表示埃塞俄比亚应参与维护红海与非洲之角安全的地区机制
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: French and Danish Defense Attachés underscored Ethiopia’s legitimate interest in Red Sea access and its potential role in safeguarding maritime security and combating terrorism

key_facts.fact: 法国国防武官Cypryk称埃塞俄比亚对红海出海通道的诉求是正当的
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Access to the Red Sea for Ethiopia is a perfectly legitimate act because it is a question of development and stability

key_facts.fact: 丹麦国防武官Lakjer称埃塞俄比亚可在反恐和应对海上安全威胁方面发挥重要作用
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Ethiopia can play a very important role in terms of fighting terrorism and also all the threats against maritime security in the area

key_facts.fact: 法国支持通过对话与谈判处理埃塞俄比亚出海通道问题
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: France supports dialogue and negotiations as the appropriate means of addressing Ethiopia’s quest for sea access

key_facts.fact: 埃塞俄比亚正积极寻求红海永久出海通道
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Currently, Ethiopia is actively pursuing permanent access to the Red Sea, citing its geographical, historical and economic circumstances

uncertainties: 该报道为埃塞俄比亚通讯社单一来源，尚无其他来源交叉验证
武官表态的具体背景与后续政策影响尚未明确
